notes.title: New Version Uploaded!
notes.notes:
Please be sure you are running version 1.19.

Changes:

[CHANGE] Removed extra input on input selection in launcher
[CHANGE] Added better controller support, added sensitivity
[CHANGE] By Default there is no joystick input set, so if you want to play using a controller please set your input in the launcher

[FIX] Some controller models not getting input from any key (Some d-pads are still not functional)

[CHANGE] Doubled the time text stay in the intro scene, so you have time to read the whole story

Thank you all for the reports and have a blast!

(Restarting Steam can trigger the download if you are not updated)

notes.title: New Version Uploaded!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone be sure you have version 1.18 now since we added some features asked by the community.

[h1]Version Changes:[/h1]
[List]
[*][FIX] Fixed a small bug with the boss barrier switch delaying/getting wrong input

[*][FIX] Fixed A small graphical glitch with the water on some parts.

[*][CHANGE] Game over screen is gone, now you restart from save after dead

[*][CHANGE] Boss Difficulty lowered a little.

[*][CHANGE] Water is not lethal, only slows you down.
[/List]

We hope you like it!
Please be sure to share your comments/suggestions!
